CHANDAN KUMAR

Senior Software Engineer

+91-7899092062 | chandan.dxc1@gmail.com

PROFILE SUMMARY:

Senior Java Developer with 8+ years of experience in building scalable, high-performance microservices and web applications. Expertise in Core Java (8/11/17), Spring Boot, Microservices, AWS Cloud, Kafka, Docker, and Kubernetes. Adept in designing RESTful APIs, writing clean and maintainable code, and driving Agile processes. Seeking to leverage these skills to contribute to backend development and cloud-based projects in a growth-oriented organization.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

Senior Software Engineer in EPAM Systems, Bangalore from 7th Feb. 2022 to Present.

Associate - Projects in Cognizant Technology Solutions, Bangalore from 3rd March 2020 to 4th February 2022.

Software Engineer in DXC Technology, Bangalore from 4th January 2017 to 2nd March 2020.

SKILLS:

Programming Languages: Core Java 8/11/17

Frameworks: Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, Amazon Web service (AWS), Apache Kafka, API Gateway

DevOps Tools: Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD (Jenkins), SVN, Log4J, SonarQube

Build & Dependency Management: Maven, Gradle

Testing & Debugging Tools: JUnit, Mockito, Postman, SoapUI

IDEs: Eclipse, Spring Tool Suite, IntelliJ

Databases: MySQL, SQL and MongoDB

Web Services: RESTful Web Services, Microservices, SOAP

Additional Technologies: Spring Data JPA, JDBC, Spring Cloud Gateway, JSON, XML, Design Pattern, Redis,

Server: Apache Tomcat, WebLogic.

UI: HTML, CSS, JSP, JavaScript, JQuery

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Designed and implemented scalable backend services and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and REST APIs.

Defined and enforced coding standards, design principles (SOLID, clean code), and best practices across the team.

Contributed to system architecture discussions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security in distributed applications.

Mentored junior developers through pair programming, code reviews, and technical guidance.

Optimized database schemas and queries in SQL, improving performance and reducing latency.



Ensured secure applications by implementing JWT, Spring Security, and role-based access controls.

Built CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and containerized services using Docker & Kubernetes.

Coordinated with Product Owners and cross-functional teams in Agile environments for feature delivery.

Handled production monitoring, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis for critical issues.

EDUCATION:

Master of Computer Application

RNS Institute of Technology, Bangalore in 2015

AWARDS AND CERTIFICATIONS:

Received "Performance Champion " in Q1 2024 for outstanding performance and contributions.

Completed Full Stack Engineer Training (FSE) from Stack Route in Cognizant Technology Solution.

PROJECTS

Project: 1

Title – AutoBCP	ˆ.·.··ç.· Jan 2025 – Aug 2025

Customer – Goldman Sach Project Description:

AutoBCP is an on-prem, end-to-end automated application resiliency testing and recovery orchestration platform. In accordance with firmwide BCP policy, AutoBCP provides a testing framework with several controls to create, scope, and execute a BCP event in an automated fashion with minimal to no human intervention. AutoBCP automation enables systems to more efficiently fail over within the designated RTO and with minimal operational risk.

Technologies:

Java 8, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud Gateway, Microservices, MongoDB, Redis cache, Rest Template, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Junit and Mockito.

Project: 2

Title – Customer Admin Service Customer – aPriori

Project Description:

ˆ.·.·.·ç Mar 2022 - Dec 2024

Customer Admin Service (CAS) is an internal application which allows the Customer Success org to gain temporary access to customer environments and manage user information and application access.

Technologies:

Core Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka, MYSQL, AWS, Docker, Jenkins, Git, Maven.



Project: 3

Title – MA Shopping Porta Customer – CareFirst Healthcare Project Description:

ˆ.·.·.·ç·Apr 2020 - Feb 2022

The project is a web-based portal for MAPD customers. Customers can login/Register on the shopping portal. The application facilitates the users to select Medicare Advantage plan and submit enrollment application Details.

Technologies:

Java, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, RESTful Web services, Apache Kafka, Tomcat, PostgreSQL, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Docker, Apigee, Junit, Mockito, Dynatrace.

Project: 4

Title – Rolodoc searches	.·.·.ˆ·ç·Jul 2019 – Mar 2020

Customer – Intermountain Healthcare

Project Description:

RoloDoc searches for Intermountain credentialed healthcare providers. RoloDoc contains contact preferences (phone numbers, rounding times, call instructions, etc.) for physicians, nurse practitioners, nurse midwives, physician assistants, and all other healthcare providers at Intermountain Healthcare. Preferences stored in RoloDoc are maintained by Medical Affairs or by the physician. A Nurse Manager / Medical Staff Secretary may be able to update physician preferences at a facility.

Technologies:

Java, JSP, JavaScript, Spring Boot , Hibernate, Restful, Oracle, WebLogic

Project: 5

Title – Physician Web Profile(PWP) Customer – Intermountain Healthcare Project Description:

.ç·.·.ˆ·Jan 2017 - Jun 2019

The Physician Web Profile application is used by physicians to keep the information which appears about them on their web profiles up to date. Information is also gathered which is required for the U.S. Government mandated Network Adequacy Program for providers who are paneled on SelectHealth. The application allows access via Provider LDAP credentials, Provider identified proxy LDAP credentials, or a 90 day active PIN.

There are five steps that are to be reviewed and updated: Step 1: My Resume Step 2: My Personal Info

Step 3: My Office Info including office hours and "accepting new patients" status Step 4: Info for My Patients

Step 5: My Credentialing Info.

Technologies:

Java, JSP, Spring, Hibernate, JavaScript, Jasper Report, Oracle, WebLogic
